public.text: Figure 3.2 is a high level diagram of the Reference Architecture. Having just reviewed Section 3.1 for guidance on adoptiong ArchiMate for our own architectural documentation it was notable that this reference architecture takes a more aesthetic approach to  it's own high-level concepts and does not use the ArchiMate approach.
public.suggestedRevision: Add guidance noting that high-level, landscape diagrams and schematics can – and where appropriate should – adopt more generally consumable approaches to diagramming, in doing so acknowledging the importance of capturing high-level, landscape design concepts.. Ideally, recommend an approach and tooling.
